signup.title: Create an account
signup.subtitle: Join the grid in a few seconds.

home.heroText: A shared grid, one color at a time. Join the other players live.

pixelWars.subtitle: One pixel every {{seconds}}s. Surround enemy pixels to capture them. Scroll to zoom, right-click + drag to pan.
pixelWars.teamRushBanner: 🔥 TEAM RUSH — cooldown ÷2 for the whole team for 30s

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.empty: No one has placed a pixel yet.

descriptions.BOMB: Places a 3x3 block of your team's color in a single placement.
descriptions.CAFE: -50% cooldown on your next placements (more placements per tier).
descriptions.RAFALE: Your next placements fully skip the cooldown (more charges per tier).
descriptions.SHIELD: Your whole team is immune to capture (longer duration per tier).
descriptions.FRENZY: Doubles your combo points on your next placements (more charges per tier).
descriptions.FORTRESS: Your next placed cell becomes uncapturable (longer duration per tier).

skins.intro: {{points}} pts — purely cosmetic, only visible to you, recolors/redraws only your own team.

territory.title: Territory
territory.text: Each player belongs to a team (Red or Blue), assigned automatically to balance headcounts. A placement always colors the cell in your team's color.

combos.title: Combos
combos.text: Line up 5 or more pixels of your color (horizontal, vertical or diagonal), or complete a solid 3x3-or-larger square: both can stack on a single placement.

capture.title: Encirclement capture
capture.text: If a group of enemy pixels ends up entirely bordered by your team's pixels — no neutral cell, no exposed map edge — it is captured and switches to your color. An active team shield, or a fortified cell, temporarily blocks this kind of capture.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.text: Cosmetic skins (the "Appearance" shop) let you recolor your own team's color, only on your screen — other players still see your team's official color.

descriptions.STRATEGE: Buy at least one of each perk type.
descriptions.VETERAN_EQUIPE: Contribute 3 times to the team pool.
